diagnosis: Check C1 is leaking because it passes in every rollout despite the decision-maker never having access to PF1 (the specific credit requirement). The models are defaulting to using the track name 'Static Bloom' as the music_credit, which satisfies C1 by pattern-matching the track title to the credit field without needing the hidden instruction for the exact string 'Written by Celia Voss'.

C1.why: The publishing license makes "Static Bloom" usable only with a cue no longer than exactly 42 seconds and the exact credit "Written by Celia Voss," rather than allowing an unrestricted shortlist choice.
